parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField on SQLite, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of adding fields to models by remaking the table for more cases than necessary, which could lead to performance regressions or other unforeseen issues.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or other issues.
